cabinet_terms_title: Before you make a cabinet token
cabinet_terms_intro: A cabinet token lets an arcade cabinet send Waddamburo plays to TaikOnline. Read this carefully. You can't use this feature unless you accept it.
cabinet_terms_money_purpose: Arcade mode is made for fun and to recreate the experience of the original arcade.
cabinet_terms_money_forbidden: USING IT TO MAKE MONEY IS STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.
cabinet_terms_money_detail: No coin-op, no paid plays, no commercial venues, no charging anyone in any way. Any token used to make money will be terminated.
cabinet_terms_one_text: Each physical cabinet you own or operate gets its own token. Never reuse one across machines.
cabinet_terms_share_title: Never share, sell or publish a token. We will know.
cabinet_terms_share_text: Every token is tied to your account and every request it makes is logged. If a token is copied, spread around or used on bootleg setups, it will be traced back to you.
cabinet_terms_terminate_title: Tokens can and will be terminated.
cabinet_terms_terminate_text: At any time, for any reason, without warning. If your account is banned, all your tokens stop working with it.
cabinet_terms_liability_text: TaikOnline and Waddamburo take no responsibility for how a cabinet token is used or misused. You alone are responsible for every cabinet running your tokens.
cabinet_terms_misuse: Misuse can cost you your tokens, the ability to make new ones, and your account.
cabinet_terms_checkbox: I have read and accept these terms, and I take full responsibility for every token I make.
cabinet_terms_checkbox_money: I will never use arcade mode to make money.
